narrative.overview:
The page is a certificate-grade timepiece laid on Stone paper. The decision Araiven makes is shown as a movement: a dial whose hand settles on a score, gears that turn as gates engage, a receipt that totals a weighted score, a calibration track that draws as the roadmap advances. A few very large rounded Gunmetal case panels are set into the paper like instruments into a bench, and ruled, engraved hairline structure carries the space between them.

Stone paper is the ground and Gunmetal is the case. Amber has four jobs and no others: the jewel, the hand and marker, the action colour, and exactly one committed full-bleed panel (the risk guard) where ink sits on Amber. Display type is Familjen Grotesk, tight and large; Albert Sans reads; Martian Mono only marks dials and tabular data.
keyCharacteristics: Large rounded Gunmetal case panels (28 to 48px radius) inset into Stone paper with an 8 to 18px frame.
Exactly one full-bleed Amber panel, and it is the risk guard.
Semantic custom properties flip inside .rv-case and .rv-amber so every component works on paper, Gunmetal or Amber.
Signature components are mechanical: dial, gear train, certificate receipt, calibration track.
Ruled lists and hairlines carry structure; 1.5px ink top rules start each ruled list.
Depth is tonal; one soft lift under the hero instrument.

rules.name: The One Panel Rule
rules.body: Exactly one panel is flooded with Amber, and it is the one about the user's drawdown cap. On it text and rules are ink, the focus ring is ink and no other chroma appears.

rules.name: The Jewel Rule
rules.body: Amber is a small bright object (stone, hand, marker, bullet, node, button), never a fill behind content, a tint on idle cards, or a gradient.

rules.name: The Deep On Paper Rule
rules.body: Amber text on paper is Amber Deep (#b45309); Amber Lift is for Gunmetal. Never set #f59e0b as small text on Stone.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only on market data and verdict chips, in the variant matched to the ground.

rules.name: The Mono Is A Dial Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono marks dials, scores, prices, times, tickers and status chips. Prose, buttons and headings never use it.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Display and headline tracking stays between -0.015em and -0.06em; large size and tight tracking are the voice.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate with 1px rules or a tonal step. A shadow belongs to the hero instrument only.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No blurred glows, gradient fills or frosted glass; the only gradients are the marquee edge mask and the hero ring mask.

rules.name: The Visible By Default Rule
rules.body: Content is readable without script or entrance animation; reveal state is added by JS only, and keyframes supply entrances, not content.

rules.name: The One Easing Rule
rules.body: New entrances and state changes use --ease (cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1)); do not introduce bounce or elastic curves.

dos: Do frame every major section as a rounded Gunmetal case panel on Stone paper, or as ruled rows with a 1.5px ink top rule and 1px interior rules, before reaching for a card.
Do use the semantic variables (--t, --b, --m, --r, --s, --s2, --acc) in components so they work on paper, Gunmetal and Amber.
Do keep Amber (#f59e0b) for jewels, hands, markers, action fills and the single risk panel; use Amber Lift (#fbbf24) for text on Gunmetal and Amber Deep (#b45309) for small text on paper.
Do set dial numerals, scores, prices, times and chips in Martian Mono with tabular numerals.
Do label demo figures as illustrative and pair green and red with a sign or label (PRODUCT.md).
Do keep the 2px focus ring in --focus and honour prefers-reduced-motion for every new animation.
donts: Don't add a second full-bleed Amber panel, gradient fills, glows, frosted glass or icon tiles.
Don't set Martian Mono in prose, buttons or headings.
Don't set #f59e0b as small text on Stone paper.
Don't apply the landing tokens to the auth pages or dashboard; they remain on the previous world until a migration is decided.
Don't invent testimonials, logos, user counts or performance claims; none exist (PRODUCT.md).
Don't put shadows on rows or cards; the hero instrument lift is the only shadow.
